latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor for Content Creators — initial release (v1.0.0):

- Instantly edit and export creator videos by uploading raw footage and describing desired edits—no timeline, no manual exports.
- Automatic setup with easy token management; supports free anonymous tokens with session handling.
- Processes tasks on remote GPU nodes; delivers 1080p videos in minutes with support for common file formats.
- Handles user queries for uploading, editing, exporting, checking credits, and session status via intuitive keyword routing.
- Provides robust error handling, fast cloud rendering, and workflow tips for efficient content creation.
